_comment: Stage mapping, section 8.2 of the brief. This is configuration, not code, so a stage
name change can be corrected without a redeploy.
byStageId is the correct long term key: a HubSpot deal stage has an opaque internal id
and a display label that any CRM user can rename. Keying on the label means an ordinary
rename silently breaks the funnel. byStageId is empty until the schema discovery in
byLabel handles the stage names currently observed arriving at Meta. Matching is case
insensitive and whitespace insensitive, which is why QUALIFIED and QualifiedLead are
listed separately rather than being assumed equivalent by normalisation alone.
Anything not listed here lands in unmapped and is surfaced on the data health panel.
A non zero unmapped count means a stage name has changed and the funnel is silently wrong.
_ignoreComment: LEADS is not a stage. It is listed so it does not inflate the unmapped alarm, but it is excluded from every funnel count.

cumulative._comment: Quotes issued is defined as deals at quote stage or beyond, and qualified likewise. A deal that reached won also counts as quoted and qualified.

deadReasons._comment: Panel 2 shows dead leads as a separate branch with a reason breakdown.
deadReasons.Unqualified: Did not meet credit or business criteria
deadReasons.BAD: Bad data or bad faith enquiry
